facts.text: The SIUE Commitment covers the balance of tuition, mandatory fees, and course fees for qualifying Illinois students with family income under $113,575 and assets under $50,000.

sources.title: The SIUE Commitment - Scholarships | SIUE
sources.quote: For qualifying Illinois students, SIUE will help close the gap in tuition, mandatory fees and course-specific fees after utilizing financial aid from all federal, state and institutional sources, including merit-based scholarships.

sources.title: The SIUE Commitment - Scholarships | SIUE
sources.quote: Incoming dependent freshmen or transfer students with family income less than $113,575 and assets less than $50,000 based on submitted Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA).
